policy: Exact installed parser/source outranks skills, guides, examples, and historical plans.

locked_claims: Ordinary base types are Form, Spell, Perk, Item, Shout, LevSpell, Package, Outfit, Keyword, Faction, SleepOutfit, and Skin.
ExclusiveGroup is a special two-field key parsed before ordinary distribution.
On-death keys use [Final]Death<Type> and the normal seven-field layout.
Linked keys use [Global]Linked[Final][Death]<Type> and a four-field layout.
Weapon is not a supported distribution type key.
LevelFilters actor ranges require both slash endpoints.
TraitFilters split on forward slash and D/-D are valid.
Chance may have one deterministic exclamation mark.
Offline validation must be field-aware and normalize runtime-accepted INI comments.
Ordinary Keyword rows use five possible positions and require a human-readable type in field 2.
GetType performs exact lookup against human-readable labels; record signatures and blank ordinary types resolve to kNone.
ExclusiveGroup is a separate key using GroupName|KeywordFormFilters.
Trailing optional ordinary positions may be omitted.
Pipe syntax
Forms/References sections
Transforms/Properties direct override sections
Whitespace inside transform/property invocation arguments is a production failure shape.
The dedicated BOS auditor must scan transform syntax as well as duplicate targets.
Configuration must be beneath a category directory
Operations are category/version-specific
JSON rules are read from Data/SKSE/Plugins/ContainerDistributionFramework.
add is an array of exact form strings.
An unresolved add string causes that change to be skipped.
Wildcard-like category strings are not expanded by the pinned parser.
Feature descriptors are loaded from Data/Shaders/Features/<ShortName>.ini.
A failed descriptor load disables the feature.
Image Based Lighting uses the short name ImageBasedLighting.
FLM configurations use _FLM.ini or Data/FLM.
FLM special selectors such as *FormList, #Group, and #Collection are framework-specific.
FLM collections resolve exact keyword forms/EditorIDs and may depend on KID completion.
Missing forms are skipped and must be classified by dependency scope.
